items.change: Sir Phidipaldi obtained Sir Brandon's magical dragon-slaying sword and set out a step-by-step plan for hunting the dragon.
items.impact_basis: Beats show Phidipaldi taking the non-cursed magical sword that killed the dragon in legend and laying out the full hunt plan, a major advance toward the main goal.
items.lasting_basis: The sword is the party's key weapon against the dragon and proof for the reeve, so it will shape later Sessions.

items.change: The party planned to pay Lady Hilda with an advance squeezed from the reeve.
items.impact_basis: Only the plan beat touches Hilda, adding a funding source to an already pending hiring.
items.lasting_basis: The payment plan will likely come up when the party returns to town.

items.change: Drop Dead Ned was formally hired on a kickback deal and offered to buy the goblin bodies.
items.impact_basis: Beats establish Ned's hiring for 100 gold with 10 gold back per murder and the body his, plus an offer for goblin corpses that conflicts with the goblins.
items.lasting_basis: Ned is now a companion with an ongoing grisly arrangement likely to recur.

items.change: Getting the mithril shirt through Dunk's scheme was set as the next step of the plan, but nothing else changed.
items.impact_basis: Only the plan beat mentions the shirt, repeating an existing intention.
items.lasting_basis: The shirt remains a pending goal for later Sessions.

items.change: Squints proved himself by killing the gray ooze and began acting as Trout's apprentice.
items.impact_basis: Beats show Squints's kill, Trout's praise, and Squints directing Dirk, a small development of the relationship.
items.lasting_basis: Squints's growing role may matter in later Sessions but mostly colored this one.

items.change: Nothing lasting changed; Dunk's potion scheme was simply restated in the plan.
items.impact_basis: Only the plan beat refers to the scheme, repeating it.
items.lasting_basis: The debt to Ingrid stands unchanged.

items.change: The party found Sir Brandon's sword in his sarcophagus and Sir Phidipaldi took it, completing the retrieval.
items.impact_basis: Beats show the party entering the tomb, opening the sarcophagus and taking the magical sword, resolving the thread.
items.lasting_basis: Possessing the sword closes this quest and enables the dragon hunt.

items.change: The party learned an angry undead giant with a greatsword, likely Brandon's companion Alfred, roams the mound, and it appeared in the tomb doorway.
items.impact_basis: Goblin and slime reports, the slaughtered goblins, and the seven-foot skeleton's arrival reveal a major new foe now confronting the party.
items.lasting_basis: The confrontation is imminent and will carry into the next Session.

items.change: Sir Phidipaldi, posing as Brandon's son, struck a bargain with the Free Goblin Society to clear the mound and hide them from King Hogboon in exchange for their company and Brandon's goods.
items.impact_basis: Beats show the goblins agreeing to the deal and granting the party their finds, a new alliance with obligations.
items.lasting_basis: The unfinished promise to clear the mound and keep them secret from Hogboon will shape later play.

items.change: Dr. Uriah donned the robes of Saint Arthur and Trout took the 600-gold chalice over Brother Dirk's objections, straining relations with the church's representative.
items.impact_basis: Beats show Dirk deeply offended by Uriah wearing the holy robes and the chalice's ownership left unresolved.
items.lasting_basis: The untested robes and the disputed chalice are likely to resurface with Dirk and the church.

items.change: The party answered a mysterious female voice's riddle and opened the stone doors behind an unidentified noblewoman statue.
items.impact_basis: Beats show the hidden room, the unknown statue and the riddle opening the doors, a notable discovery with an open mystery.
items.lasting_basis: The voice and statue's identity remain unexplained and may come up again.

items.change: The party noted that the antechamber mosaics are inlaid with real gemstones.
items.impact_basis: The beat adds descriptive detail of possible treasure without changing the situation.
items.lasting_basis: The gemstones might tempt the party later but nothing was decided.

items.change: Dr. Uriah found a jeweled ceremonial dagger worth over 200 gold.
items.impact_basis: The beat is a treasure find with no other effect.
items.lasting_basis: Ordinary valuable treasure mattered mostly within the Session.

items.change: Dr. Uriah discovered a secret room in the crypt holding a dark-wood chest and golden candleholders.
items.impact_basis: The beat reveals a hidden room and an unopened chest, a minor discovery.
items.lasting_basis: The chest's contents may matter but the room mostly mattered this Session.

items.change: The party took seven gold candleholders worth 50 gold each.
items.impact_basis: The beat is ordinary treasure gained.
items.lasting_basis: Ordinary treasure has little lasting effect.

items.change: Sir Phidipaldi found the five urns held only dust but are worth 100 gold each.
items.impact_basis: The beat is an ordinary treasure appraisal.
items.lasting_basis: Ordinary treasure has little lasting effect.
